question: What alternative building forms are noted among buildings, including those devoid of corner pavilions?
premises: A form devoid of corner pavilion is mentioned.
All these are considered in buildings.
inference: Or else (forms) devoid of corner pavilions, and other all (forms) are (noted) among buildings.
uncertainties: Scope of 'anyat sarvaṃ tu vāstuṣu' is compressed in this verse.
plain_english: Or else devoid of corner pavilions, and other things all, among buildings.
